text:
fran (prod-designer): Quick follow-up from research: users keep reading the preview stacks as progress bars. We need clearer semantics and lighter visuals for the rules preview.
yusuf (frontend): Agreed. Two quick fixes: reduce visual bar height to 6px and move percent labels to a separate right column. That should stop the progress metaphor.
kim (pm): Also heard confusion about the label 'Weight' in the legend. Propose 'Relative weight (%)' and add a small hint: 'higher weight = more routed traffic'.
ben (engineer): Implementation notes: keep drag handle hit area 44px even if the bar is thin. We'll use invisible padding around the handle. Also need stable rule IDs to memoize percent calc.
a11y-bot: :warning: Contrast check: current accent-green on white for 12px labels fails 3:1. Recommend neutral-900 or accent-700 token for small text. Also require aria-live on validation messages.
fran (prod-designer): Thanks. I'll swap to neutral-900 for labels and add an info icon next to each percent showing the formula and a short example (e.g. "25% ~ 25 req/min").
yusuf (frontend): Keyboard reorder bug: when preview overlay toggles, focus ring disappears. The overlay element has pointer-events:none but still steals focus CSS. I'll fix by moving overlay outside of focus context.
kim (pm): Validation copy needs to be more actionable. Drafts: 
- Overlap: "Rule 'Beta' overlaps 'Default'. Make targets mutually exclusive or reduce priority"
- Unsupported target: "Target 'eu-north-9' not supported. Edit or remove."
- Preview stale: "Preview out of date. Run preview to validate current changes."
ben (engineer): Those work. For samples view we need a backend call for est.req/min; we'll cache per-policy and show a skeleton while fetching. If the policy is unsaved, show an em dash with tooltip 'Unavailable for unsaved configs'.
a11y-bot: :white_check_mark: Accessibility suggestion: maintain 44px touch target, ensure contrast 4.5:1 for <14px, and make overlap errors announce via aria-live="assertive".
fran (prod-designer): Great. I'll update Figma with the thinner bars, right-aligned percent column, new legend copy, and token swaps. Will also include the samples toggle as an explicit pill: 'View: % | samples'.
yusuf (frontend): I'll implement CSS vars: `--preview-bar-h:6px; --preview-handle-hit:44px; --preview-gap:10px;`. Will include focus fixes and percent calc memoization in the same PR.
kim (pm): Who can pair on the microcopy + a11y checks? I can take copy; need eng to confirm tooltip lengths.
ben (engineer): I can pair for 20m after standup to check IDs and caching TTL.
fran (prod-designer): Thanks team 496 I'll post the new frames and a brief copy list here when ready.
